content: अमतिः [अम्-अति <ls>Uṇ. 4. 59.</ls>] .²1 Time. .²2 The moon. .²3 (<ab>Ved.</ab>) Form, shape (<ls>Nir.</ls>). .²4 Want, poverty. {%a.%} poor, indigent; अनापिरज्ञा असजात्यामतिः <ls>Rv. 10. 39. 6</ls>. .{@-अमतीवन्@} {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Evil-minded, wicked (दुष्ट, अप्रशस्तबुद्धिमत् <ls>Sāy.</ls>). .²2 Poor, indigent; न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया <ls>Rv. 8. 19. 26</ls>.

अमति {%a.%} Evil-minded, wicked, depraved. .{@-तिः@} A rogue, cheat. .{@-तिः@} {%f.%} .²1 Ignorance, unconsciousness, absence of knowledge, intention, or fore-thought; अमत्यैतानि षड् जग्ध्वा <ls>Ms. 5. 20</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 222</ls>. For some of the other senses see under अम्.
